gates.requiredScope: Exact intended candidate has clean whitespace, complete path inventory, no protected or generated output, and no placeholders.
gates.rationale: Every delivery candidate requires exact staged-scope proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while this feature changes tracked files.

gates.requiredScope: Feature-034 positive and negative closure validation proves exact PR provenance and 15/6/10/10/10 cardinalities.
gates.rationale: Wave closure requires deterministic fail-closed evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while Feature 034 is the Wave-5 closure gate.

gates.requiredScope: All Tp7, Wave5Functional, and Wave5Showcase real app-loop tests pass in Release.
gates.rationale: The combined audit must execute both delivered quality layers.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while the ten Wave-5 examples are audited.

gates.requiredScope: All ten projects pass controlled smoke and normal PTY keyboard paths with primary action, F1, and Ctrl+Q.
gates.rationale: Test construction does not replace runnable entry-point proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Never while runnable examples form the closure scope.

gates.requiredScope: The complete solution Release test suite passes.
gates.rationale: Wave eligibility is a repository-wide release claim.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if the binding intake is formally changed.

gates.requiredScope: Canonical Coverlet collection keeps all five required framework assemblies at or above 70 percent line coverage.
gates.rationale: Repository merge policy requires the five-assembly coverage gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if the Constitution and repository gate change.

gates.requiredScope: DocFX builds without warnings or errors and Playwright/Axe documentation smoke passes.
gates.rationale: Learner-facing closure and Wave-6 intake documentation change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if no learner-facing or DocFX surface changes.

gates.requiredScope: Ubuntu executes the actual repository Release and Wave-5 acceptance body.
gates.rationale: Wave closure requires a Linux result.

gates.requiredScope: macOS executes the actual repository Release and Wave-5 acceptance body.
gates.rationale: macOS is a primary development and runtime platform.

gates.requiredScope: Windows executes the actual repository Release and Wave-5 acceptance body plus PowerShell state parity.
gates.rationale: Windows and PowerShell parity are repository requirements.

gates.requiredScope: Repository dependency, secret, and supply-chain checks pass on the reviewed head.
gates.rationale: NIST SSDF and MergeAndSync delivery governance remain applicable.

gates.requiredScope: All five maintained agent guidance surfaces are semantically synchronized.
gates.rationale: Active feature and Wave outcome affect maintained context.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Only if no shared guidance or marker changes.

gates.requiredScope: No new or changed repository script requires Bash and PowerShell parity.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any added or changed .sh or .ps1 file.
